settings.text: Upgrade your living space with this elegant 2-tier moving side table designed for both style and convenience. The table features a practical two-level layout that gives you extra surface space for drinks, books, decor, or daily essentials while keeping your room organized. Its real wooden legs add a warm natural touch, while the smooth caster wheels make it easy to move from the living room to the bedroom, reading corner, or office. The raised tray-style shelves help keep items secure during movement, making it a smart choice for compact homes and flexible interiors. With its clean design and mobile structure, this table blends beautifully into modern, Scandinavian, minimalist, or contemporary spaces.

settings.heading: Product features
settings.row_content:
• Smooth Caster Wheels: Four 360° swivel wheels allow effortless movement across different floor surfaces.member.
  • Easy Positioning: Move the table wherever you need it, whether beside a sofa, bed, or armchair.
  • Convenient Mobility: Ideal for homes that need flexible furniture for cleaning or rearranging.
  • Space-Saving Layout: Vertical storage keeps the footprint compact while increasing usefulness.
  • Modern Appeal: Blends easily with light, neutral, and Scandinavian-style interiors.

settings.heading: Materials
settings.row_content:
Real Wooden Legs

  • Natural Look: Wooden legs add warmth and a premium furniture feel.
  • Stable Structure: The legs provide solid support and balance for everyday use.

Tray material: High-density polypropylene (PP) or ABS plastic for the tray top, shelves, and frame—lightweight, durable, and waterproof.

Finish: Smooth matte white plastic finish—scratch-resistant, easy-clean surface.

settings.heading: Care Instructions
settings.row_content:
• Wipe the tabletop and frame with a soft, dry or slightly damp microfiber cloth.
  • Avoid harsh chemicals, abrasive pads, and excess water, especially on wooden parts.
  • Clean the caster wheels regularly to remove dust, hair, or debris so they roll smoothly.
  • If wheels become stiff, use a small amount of silicone spray on the axle or moving parts.
  • Tighten screws and fittings periodically to keep the table stable and wobble-free.
  • Keep the table away from prolonged moisture and direct sunlight to preserve the wood finish
